subject: math
title: Grade 8 Operations with Fractions
seo_title: Grade 8 Operations with Fractions Worksheets: Mixed Numbers, Multiplying, Dividing and BEDMAS (Free, Answer Key, Ontario)
standard_text: Multiply and divide fractions by fractions, as well as by whole numbers and mixed numbers, in various contexts
meta_desc: Free Grade 8 math worksheets on operations with fractions for the Ontario curriculum: adding and subtracting with unlike denominators and mixed numbers, multiplying and dividing fractions and mixed numbers, BEDMAS and word problems. 100 questions with an answer key.
key_big: Add and subtract with a common denominator. Multiply straight across. To divide, multiply by the reciprocal. Change mixed numbers to improper fractions before you multiply or divide.
key_sub: 1/3 + 1/4 = 4/12 + 3/12 = 7/12, not 2/7. 1 1/2 × 2 1/3 = 3/2 × 7/3 = 3 1/2, not 2 1/6. With more than one operation, follow BEDMAS.
body_html:
The big idea

Add and subtract with a common denominator. Multiply straight across. Divide by multiplying by the reciprocal. Change mixed numbers to improper fractions before you multiply or divide. When there is more than one operation, follow BEDMAS.

Add and subtract

Rename the fractions with a common denominator. Then add or subtract the numerators only. The denominator tells the size of the pieces, so it stays the same.

Example 1

3 56 + 2 34 = ?

Whole numbers: 3 + 2 = 5. Fractions: 1012 + 912 = 1912 = 1 712. 5 + 1 712 = 6 712.

Answer: 6 712

Example 2

5 14 − 2 23 = ?

14 is less than 23, so use improper fractions: 6312 − 3212 = 3112 = 2 712.

Answer: 2 712

Multiply

Multiply the numerators and multiply the denominators. Simplify. Mixed numbers must become improper fractions first.

Example 3

1 12 × 2 13 = ?

32 × 73 = 216 = 3 12.

Answer: 3 12

Divide

Keep the first number, change ÷ to ×, and flip the divisor (use its reciprocal).

Example 4

3 34 ÷ 1 14 = ?

154 ÷ 54 = 154 × 45 = 6020 = 3. Check: 3 × 1 14 = 3 34.

Answer: 3

More than one operation: BEDMAS

Brackets, Exponents, Division and Multiplication (left to right), Addition and Subtraction (left to right).

Example 5

12 + 14 × 23 = ?

Multiply first: 14 × 23 = 212 = 16. Then 36 + 16 = 46 = 23.

Answer: 23

OperationCommon denominator?Mixed numbers
+ and −YesAdd wholes and fractions, or use improper fractions
×NoChange to improper fractions first
÷NoChange to improper fractions, then multiply by the reciprocal

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
13 + 14 = 27 (adding the denominators)Use a common denominator: 412 + 312 = 712.
1 12 × 2 13 = 2 16 (multiplying whole parts and fraction parts separately)Change to improper fractions first: 32 × 73 = 3 12.
45 ÷ 23 = 54 × 23 (flipping the wrong fraction)Flip only the divisor: 45 × 32 = 1 15.
5 14 − 2 23 = 3 512 (subtracting the smaller fraction from the larger)Regroup 1 whole, or use improper fractions: the answer is 2 712.
12 + 12 × 12 = 12 (working left to right)Multiply first: 12 + 14 = 34.

faq.q: How do you add and subtract fractions with different denominators?
faq.a: Rename the fractions with a common denominator, then add or subtract the numerators only. For example, 1/3 + 1/4 = 4/12 + 3/12 = 7/12, not 2/7.

faq.q: How do you multiply mixed numbers in Grade 8?
faq.a: Change each mixed number to an improper fraction, multiply the numerators and the denominators, then simplify. For example, 1 1/2 × 2 1/3 = 3/2 × 7/3 = 21/6 = 3 1/2.

faq.q: How do you divide a fraction by a fraction?
faq.a: Keep the first fraction, change ÷ to ×, and flip the second fraction (use its reciprocal). For example, 3/4 ÷ 3/8 = 3/4 × 8/3 = 2.

faq.q: What order of operations do Ontario students use with fractions?
faq.a: Ontario classrooms use BEDMAS: brackets, exponents, division and multiplication from left to right, then addition and subtraction from left to right. For example, 1/2 + 1/4 × 2/3 = 1/2 + 1/6 = 2/3.

sets.title: Add and subtract with unlike denominators and mixed numbers

items.q: The bottom bar shows 13 + 14 in twelfths. What is 13 + 14?
items.e: 13 = 412 (4 twelfths) and 14 = 312 (3 twelfths). Together: 412 + 312 = 712.

items.q:
34 + 16 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Use the common denominator 12: 34 = 912 and 16 = 212. 912 + 212 = 1112. The answer is 1112.

items.q:
25 + 13 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Use the common denominator 15: 25 = 615 and 13 = 515. 615 + 515 = 1115. The answer is 1115.

items.q:
56 + 38 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Use the common denominator 24: 56 = 2024 and 38 = 924. 2024 + 924 = 2924 = 1 524. The answer is 1 524.

items.q:
710 + 14 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Use the common denominator 20: 710 = 1420 and 14 = 520. 1420 + 520 = 1920. The answer is 1920.

items.q:
23 + 49 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Use the common denominator 9: 23 = 69. 69 + 49 = 109 = 1 19. The answer is 1 19.

items.q:
56 − 14 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Use the common denominator 12: 56 = 1012 and 14 = 312. 1012 − 312 = 712. The answer is 712.

items.q:
34 − 25 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Use the common denominator 20: 34 = 1520 and 25 = 820. 1520 − 820 = 720. The answer is 720.

items.q:
78 − 16 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Use the common denominator 24: 78 = 2124 and 16 = 424. 2124 − 424 = 1724. The answer is 1724.

items.q:
910 − 34 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Use the common denominator 20: 910 = 1820 and 34 = 1520. 1820 − 1520 = 320. The answer is 320.

items.q:
2 13 + 1 14 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Add the whole numbers: 2 + 1 = 3. Add the fractions with denominator 12: 412 + 312 = 712. So the sum is 3 712.

items.q:
3 56 + 2 34 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Add the whole numbers: 3 + 2 = 5. Add the fractions with denominator 12: 1012 + 912 = 1912 = 1 712. 5 + 1 712 = 6 712.

items.q:
1 25 + 4 12 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Add the whole numbers: 1 + 4 = 5. Add the fractions with denominator 10: 410 + 510 = 910. So the sum is 5 910.

items.q:
5 38 + 2 56 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Add the whole numbers: 5 + 2 = 7. Add the fractions with denominator 24: 924 + 2024 = 2924 = 1 524. 7 + 1 524 = 8 524.

items.q:
4 34 − 1 13 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change to improper fractions with denominator 12: 4 34 = 5712 and 1 13 = 1612. 5712 − 1612 = 4112 = 3 512. The answer is 3 512.

items.q:
5 14 − 2 23 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change to improper fractions with denominator 12: 5 14 = 6312 and 2 23 = 3212. 6312 − 3212 = 3112 = 2 712. The answer is 2 712.

items.q:
6 16 − 3 34 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change to improper fractions with denominator 12: 6 16 = 7412 and 3 34 = 4512. 7412 − 4512 = 2912 = 2 512. The answer is 2 512.

items.q: 3 − 1 25 = ?
items.e: Write 3 as 2 55. Then 2 55 − 1 25 = 1 35.

items.q: 34 − ? = 16
items.e: The missing number is 34 − 16. With denominator 12: 912 − 212 = 712. Check: 34 − 712 = 912 − 712 = 212 = 16.

items.q: A student writes 23 + 15 = 38. What is the mistake?
items.e: Only the numerators are added, and only after the denominators are the same: 1015 + 315 = 1315, not 38.

items.q: The light part is 34 of the square. The dark part is 23 of the light part. What is 23 × 34?
items.e: The square is cut into 4 × 3 = 12 small rectangles, and 3 × 2 = 6 of them are dark. 23 × 34 = 2 × 33 × 4 = 612 = 12. The answer is 12.

items.q: The light part is 12 of the square. The dark part is 35 of the light part. What is 35 × 12?
items.e: The square is cut into 2 × 5 = 10 small rectangles, and 1 × 3 = 3 of them are dark. 35 × 12 = 3 × 15 × 2 = 310. The answer is 310.

items.q:
49 × 38 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: 49 × 38 = 4 × 39 × 8 = 1272 = 16. The answer is 16.

items.q:
56 × 310 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: 56 × 310 = 5 × 36 × 10 = 1560 = 14. The answer is 14.

items.q:
712 × 47 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: 712 × 47 = 7 × 412 × 7 = 2884 = 13. The answer is 13.

items.q:
25 × 58 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: 25 × 58 = 2 × 55 × 8 = 1040 = 14. The answer is 14.

items.q:
58 × 415 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: 58 × 415 = 5 × 48 × 15 = 20120 = 16. The answer is 16.

items.q:
6 × 1 34 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 1 34 = 74. 61 × 74 = 6 × 71 × 4 = 424 = 212 = 10 12. The answer is 10 12.

items.q:
34 × 2 23 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 2 23 = 83. 34 × 83 = 3 × 84 × 3 = 2412 = 2. The answer is 2.

items.q:
3 13 × 35 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 3 13 = 103. 103 × 35 = 10 × 33 × 5 = 3015 = 2. The answer is 2.

items.q:
56 × 9 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: 56 × 91 = 5 × 96 × 1 = 456 = 152 = 7 12. The answer is 7 12.

items.q:
2 34 × 4 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 2 34 = 114. 114 × 41 = 11 × 44 × 1 = 444 = 11. The answer is 11.

items.q:
1 12 × 2 13 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 1 12 = 32, 2 13 = 73. 32 × 73 = 3 × 72 × 3 = 216 = 72 = 3 12. The answer is 3 12.

items.q:
2 14 × 1 13 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 2 14 = 94, 1 13 = 43. 94 × 43 = 9 × 44 × 3 = 3612 = 3. The answer is 3.

items.q:
3 13 × 1 15 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 3 13 = 103, 1 15 = 65. 103 × 65 = 10 × 63 × 5 = 6015 = 4. The answer is 4.

items.q:
2 25 × 1 78 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 2 25 = 125, 1 78 = 158. 125 × 158 = 12 × 155 × 8 = 18040 = 92 = 4 12. The answer is 4 12.

items.q:
1 34 × 2 27 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 1 34 = 74, 2 27 = 167. 74 × 167 = 7 × 164 × 7 = 11228 = 4. The answer is 4.

items.q: Noah says 2 12 × 2 12 = 4 14. What did he do wrong?
c: He multiplied the whole numbers and the fractions separately.
He did not simplify the answer.
items.e: 2 × 2 + 12 × 12 = 4 14 leaves out parts of the product. Change to improper fractions: 52 × 52 = 254 = 6 14.

items.q: Which is the best estimate of 3 78 × 2 19?
items.e: 3 78 is close to 4 and 2 19 is close to 2. 4 × 2 = 8. (The exact product is 8 1372.)

items.q: Without calculating, which product is less than 56?
c: 56 × 1 13
56 × 23
56 × 32
items.e: Multiplying by a number less than 1 makes the product smaller. Only 23 is less than 1, so 56 × 23 = 59 is less than 56.

sets.title: Divide by multiplying by the reciprocal

items.q: What is the reciprocal of 58?
items.e: The reciprocal swaps the numerator and the denominator: 85. Check: 58 × 85 = 1.

items.q: What is the reciprocal of 1 34?
items.e: Change to an improper fraction first: 1 34 = 74. Its reciprocal is 47. Check: 74 × 47 = 1.

items.q: The shaded part is 2 14. Each bracket is 38. How many groups of 38 are in 2 14?
items.e: 2 14 = 188, so 18 eighths are shaded. 18 ÷ 3 = 6 groups. Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 2 14 = 94. Multiply by the reciprocal of 38: 94 × 83 = 7212 = 6. The answer is 6.

items.q:
34 ÷ 38 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal of 38: 34 × 83 = 2412 = 2. The answer is 2. Check: 2 × 38 = 34.

items.q:
23 ÷ 49 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal of 49: 23 × 94 = 1812 = 32 = 1 12. The answer is 1 12. Check: 1 12 × 49 = 23.

items.q:
56 ÷ 23 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal of 23: 56 × 32 = 1512 = 54 = 1 14. The answer is 1 14. Check: 1 14 × 23 = 56.

items.q:
35 ÷ 910 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal of 910: 35 × 109 = 3045 = 23. The answer is 23. Check: 23 × 910 = 35.

items.q:
78 ÷ 14 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal of 14: 78 × 41 = 288 = 72 = 3 12. The answer is 3 12. Check: 3 12 × 14 = 78.

items.q:
89 ÷ 23 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal of 23: 89 × 32 = 2418 = 43 = 1 13. The answer is 1 13. Check: 1 13 × 23 = 89.

items.q:
4 ÷ 23 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal of 23: 41 × 32 = 122 = 6. The answer is 6. Check: 6 × 23 = 4.

items.q:
2 12 ÷ 5 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 2 12 = 52. Multiply by the reciprocal of 5: 52 × 15 = 510 = 12. The answer is 12. Check: 12 × 5 = 2 12.

items.q:
3 34 ÷ 1 14 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 3 34 = 154, 1 14 = 54. Multiply by the reciprocal of 54: 154 × 45 = 6020 = 3. The answer is 3. Check: 3 × 1 14 = 3 34.

items.q:
3 13 ÷ 1 14 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 3 13 = 103, 1 14 = 54. Multiply by the reciprocal of 54: 103 × 45 = 4015 = 83 = 2 23. The answer is 2 23. Check: 2 23 × 1 14 = 3 13.

items.q:
1 78 ÷ 34 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 1 78 = 158. Multiply by the reciprocal of 34: 158 × 43 = 6024 = 52 = 2 12. The answer is 2 12. Check: 2 12 × 34 = 1 78.

items.q:
6 ÷ 1 12 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 1 12 = 32. Multiply by the reciprocal of 32: 61 × 23 = 123 = 4. The answer is 4. Check: 4 × 1 12 = 6.

items.q:
2 14 ÷ 2 12 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 2 14 = 94, 2 12 = 52. Multiply by the reciprocal of 52: 94 × 25 = 1820 = 910. The answer is 910. Check: 910 × 2 12 = 2 14.

items.q: Which is the same as 25 ÷ 34?
c: 52 × 34
52 × 43
25 × 34
25 × 43
items.e: Keep the first fraction, change ÷ to ×, and flip the divisor: 25 × 43 = 815.

items.q: Without calculating, which is true about 56 ÷ 23?
c: It is greater than 56.
It is equal to 56.
It is less than 23.
It is less than 56.
items.e: Dividing by a number less than 1 makes the answer larger. 56 ÷ 23 = 1512 = 1 14, which is greater than 56.

items.q: Olivia says 45 ÷ 23 = 56. What did she do wrong?
c: She flipped the first fraction instead of the second.
items.e: 54 × 23 = 1012 = 56, so Olivia flipped 45. Flip only the divisor: 45 × 32 = 1210 = 1 15.

items.q: ? ÷ 12 = 34
items.e: Undo the division by multiplying: 34 × 12 = 38. Check: 38 ÷ 12 = 38 × 2 = 68 = 34.

items.q:
12 + 14 × 23 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Multiply first: 14 × 23 = 212 = 16. Then 12 + 16 = 36 + 16 = 23.

items.q:
56 − 13 ÷ 2 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Divide first: 13 ÷ 2 = 13 × 12 = 16. Then 56 − 16 = 46 = 23.

items.q:
(23 + 16) × 35 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Brackets first: 23 + 16 = 46 + 16 = 56. Then 56 × 35 = 1530 = 12.

items.q:
34 ÷ 12 × 13 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: ÷ and × have the same rank, so work from left to right. 34 ÷ 12 = 34 × 2 = 32. Then 32 × 13 = 36 = 12.

items.q:
(12)² + 34 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Exponent first: (12)² = 12 × 12 = 14. Then 14 + 34 = 44 = 1.

items.q:
2 − 34 × 23 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Multiply first: 34 × 23 = 612 = 12. Then 2 − 12 = 1 12.

items.q:
1 12 × (23 − 14) = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Brackets first: 23 − 14 = 812 − 312 = 512. Then 32 × 512 = 1524 = 58.

items.q:
45 ÷ (25 + 12) = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Brackets first: 25 + 12 = 410 + 510 = 910. Then 45 ÷ 910 = 45 × 109 = 4045 = 89.

items.q:
(34)² ÷ 38 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Exponent first: (34)² = 916. Then 916 ÷ 38 = 916 × 83 = 7248 = 1 12.

items.q:
56 − 13 + 14 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: + and − have the same rank, so work from left to right. 56 − 13 = 56 − 26 = 36. Then 12 + 14 = 24 + 14 = 34.

items.q:
3 12 − 1 14 × 2 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Multiply first: 1 14 × 2 = 54 × 2 = 104 = 2 12. Then 3 12 − 2 12 = 1.

items.q:
56 × 35 + 12 ÷ 34 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Multiply and divide first: 56 × 35 = 1530 = 12, and 12 ÷ 34 = 12 × 43 = 23. Then 12 + 23 = 36 + 46 = 76 = 1 16.

items.q:
(1 − 25) × (1 + 13) = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Brackets first: 1 − 25 = 35 and 1 + 13 = 43. Then 35 × 43 = 1215 = 45.

items.q:
78 − (12 − 14) = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Brackets first: 12 − 14 = 14. Then 78 − 14 = 78 − 28 = 58.

items.q:
23 ÷ 49 − 12 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Divide first: 23 ÷ 49 = 23 × 94 = 1812 = 32. Then 32 − 12 = 22 = 1.

items.q:
34 + 14 ÷ 12 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Divide first: 14 ÷ 12 = 14 × 2 = 12. Then 34 + 24 = 54 = 1 14.

items.q:
2 14 ÷ 34 − 1 12 = ?
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: Divide first: 2 14 ÷ 34 = 94 × 43 = 3612 = 3. Then 3 − 1 12 = 1 12.

items.q:
Evaluate 2a + b when a = 34 and b = 16.
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: 2a means 2 × a: 2 × 34 = 64 = 1 12. Then 1 12 + 16 = 1 36 + 16 = 1 23.

items.q:
Evaluate x² − x when x = 32.
Give your answer in simplest form.
items.e: x² = (32)² = 94. Then 94 − 32 = 94 − 64 = 34.

items.q: Ethan says 12 + 12 × 12 = 12. What did he do wrong?
items.e: (12 + 12) × 12 = 1 × 12 = 12, so Ethan added first. BEDMAS says multiply first: 12 × 12 = 14, then 12 + 14 = 34.

items.q: A maple cookie recipe needs 2 14 cups of flour. Owen makes 23 of the recipe. How much flour does he need?
items.e: Find 23 of 2 14: 23 × 2 14. Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 2 14 = 94. 23 × 94 = 2 × 93 × 4 = 1812 = 32 = 1 12. The answer is 1 12 cups.

items.q: A rectangular garden bed is 2 12 m long and 1 13 m wide. What is its area?
items.e: Area = length × width. Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 2 12 = 52, 1 13 = 43. 52 × 43 = 5 × 42 × 3 = 206 = 103 = 3 13. The answer is 3 13 m².

items.q: A trail in Algonquin Park is 4 12 km long. Zoe has hiked 2 23 km. How much farther does she have to go?
items.e: Change to improper fractions with denominator 6: 4 12 = 276 and 2 23 = 166. 276 − 166 = 116 = 1 56. The answer is 1 56 km.

items.q: A hockey team has 4 12 h of ice time this week. Each practice is 34 h long. How many practices can the team have?
items.e: How many 34 h practices fit in 4 12 h? 4 12 ÷ 34. Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 4 12 = 92. Multiply by the reciprocal of 34: 92 × 43 = 366 = 6. The answer is 6 practices.

items.q: A 5 14 m roll of ribbon is cut into pieces that are each 78 m long. How many pieces are there?
items.e: 5 14 ÷ 78. Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 5 14 = 214. Multiply by the reciprocal of 78: 214 × 87 = 16828 = 6. The answer is 6 pieces.

items.q: On a canoe trip, a group paddles 3 34 km before lunch and 4 23 km after lunch. How far do they paddle in all?
items.e: Add the whole numbers: 3 + 4 = 7. Add the fractions with denominator 12: 912 + 812 = 1712 = 1 512. 7 + 1 512 = 8 512 km.

items.q: Mei has $60. She spends 14 of it on a book. Then she spends 23 of the money that is left on a skating pass. How much money does she have now?
items.e: 14 of $60 = $15, so $60 − $15 = $45 is left. 23 of $45 = $30. $45 − $30 = $15. (23 of the money that is left, not 23 of $60.)

items.q: Four friends share 23 of a pizza equally. What fraction of the whole pizza does each friend get?
items.e: 23 ÷ 4. Multiply by the reciprocal of 4: 23 × 14 = 212 = 16. The answer is 16.

items.q: In a school garden, 34 of the area is vegetables. Tomatoes fill 25 of the vegetable area. What fraction of the whole garden is tomatoes?
items.e: 25 of 34 means 25 × 34. 25 × 34 = 2 × 35 × 4 = 620 = 310. The answer is 310.

items.q: It snowed 2 34 cm on Monday, 1 12 cm on Tuesday and 3 13 cm on Wednesday. How much snow fell in all?
items.e: Whole numbers: 2 + 1 + 3 = 6. Fractions with denominator 12: 912 + 612 + 412 = 1912 = 1 712. 6 + 1 712 = 7 712 cm.

items.q: A sugar shack has 12 12 L of maple syrup. It fills bottles that each hold 58 L. How many bottles can it fill?
items.e: 12 12 ÷ 58. Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 12 12 = 252. Multiply by the reciprocal of 58: 252 × 85 = 20010 = 20. The answer is 20 bottles.

items.q: Maya walks 34 km in 16 h. At this rate, how many kilometres does she walk in 1 h?
items.e: Distance ÷ time: 34 ÷ 16. Multiply by the reciprocal of 16: 34 × 61 = 184 = 92 = 4 12. The answer is 4 12 km.

items.q: A pancake recipe for 4 people uses 1 23 cups of milk. How much milk is needed for 6 people?
items.e: 6 people is 6 ÷ 4 = 1 12 times as many. Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 1 23 = 53, 1 12 = 32. 53 × 32 = 5 × 33 × 2 = 156 = 52 = 2 12. The answer is 2 12 cups.

items.q: At the cottage, Sofia cuts 3 pieces that are each 58 m long from a board that is 2 25 m long. How much of the board is left?
items.e: The pieces use 3 × 58 = 158 = 1 78 m. Use denominator 40: 2 25 = 9640 and 158 = 7540. 9640 − 7540 = 2140 m.

items.q: Benjamin paints 23 of a fence in 1 12 h. At the same rate, how long will the whole fence take?
items.e: 23 of the fence takes 1 12 h, so the whole fence takes 1 12 ÷ 23. Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 1 12 = 32. Multiply by the reciprocal of 23: 32 × 32 = 94 = 2 14. The answer is 2 14 h. Check: 23 of 2 14 h is 1 12 h.

items.q: A family drives from Ottawa to Toronto, a trip of about 450 km. They have driven 35 of the way. About how many kilometres are left?
items.e: 35 of 450 km = 450 ÷ 5 × 3 = 270 km driven. 450 − 270 = 180 km left (that is 25 of the trip).

items.q: Three students run 2 12 km, 3 14 km and 2 34 km in gym class. What is the mean distance?
items.e: Total: 2 12 + 3 14 + 2 34 = 8 12 km. Mean: 8 12 ÷ 3 = 172 × 13 = 176 = 2 56 km.

items.q: Square tiles are 38 m wide. How many tiles fit in a row along a wall that is 2 14 m long?
items.e: 2 14 ÷ 38. Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 2 14 = 94. Multiply by the reciprocal of 38: 94 × 83 = 7212 = 6. The answer is 6 tiles.

items.q: A water tank is 34 full. It holds 45 L of water now. How many litres does it hold when it is full?
items.e: 34 of the tank is 45 L, so the full tank is 45 ÷ 34 = 45 × 43 = 60 L. Check: 34 of 60 L = 45 L.

items.q: The Terry Fox Run route is 5 km. Ava walks 25 of the route and runs the rest. How many kilometres does she run?
items.e: Ava walks 25 × 5 = 2 km. The rest is 5 − 2 = 3 km. (Or 35 of 5 km = 3 km.)
